captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a compact, boxy bread maker with a light gray matte finish. On its front-right face, there is a dark control panel housing a black cylindrical timer knob and two white square buttons. The top of the machine features a shallow, rectangular recessed lid that can hinge open, while the internal cavity is designed to hold a loaf pan with a small rotating kneading paddle at the bottom.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact bread maker. The main body should be a boxy structure with a hollowed-out baking chamber, a rear-hinged top lid, and a front-right control panel featuring a rotating timer knob and two independent push buttons.
captions.factory: The code constructs the bread maker by initializing an ArticulatedObject. The main body is created from a box primitive, hollowed out to define the baking chamber. A hinged lid is modeled as a separate box with a revolute joint on the rear axis. The control panel is built using a thin box for the frame, a cylinder for the rotating timer knob (continuous joint), and two small boxes representing the independent push buttons (prismatic joints).
